jane_cust: Hi support — our org just had a promo applied (code HOLIDAY25). Dashboard shows -$5.40 remaining credits under Billing > Credits but invoice preview shows credits applied correctly (0 remaining). This started after we ran a bunch of batch embeddings.

alex_support: Sorry to hear that. Can you DM me the org id? Also what's the promo id if you have it (from the confirmation email)?

jane_cust: org: org_abc123, promo id: FC-2025-HOL. I pasted the promo confirmation: BillingBot confirmed `free_credit_id=FC-2025-HOL, amount=50.00, expires=2026-04-01`.

BillingBot: Promo code HOLIDAY25 applied to org_abc123. free_credit_id=FC-2025-HOL amount=50.00 expires=2026-04-01 metadata:{source:marketing, stack:promo-service}

alex_support: Thanks. I'm going to escalate to billing & eng. Quick question: is the negative balance visible only in dashboard UI, or does `/v1/usage` show negative remaining as well?

jane_cust: Only the dashboard. `/v1/usage` returned normal token consumption numbers; invoice preview showed the promo credit being deducted. Dashboard just shows -5.40.

matt_oncall: Adding context: we've seen a race between the promo backfill job and billing metering updates. If metering writes a usage record after the promo backfill job calculates remaining credit, UI can show a transient negative number until the ledger is reconciled. Can you share a couple of request ids around the time this happened? Look for `request_id` in response headers.

jane_cust: Found two request ids: `req_7a1b` (2026-03-15T16:02:12Z) and `req_7a1c` (2026-03-15T16:02:14Z). Also attaching snippet of curl we used to create embeddings:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-org_abc123\" \n  -d '{\"model\":\"embed-xxl\",\"input\":[...]}'
```

sara_analytics: I pulled metering logs for org_abc123. There is a backfill run at 2026-03-15T16:02:10Z that writes the promo assignment to ledger, then a high-throughput metering batch at 16:02:15Z that increments token counts. The ledger reconciliation job runs every 10 minutes; it hasn't run yet when the snapshot was taken — so UI snapshot at ~16:02:16 shows negative.

matt_oncall: Short-term workaround: manual reconcile + force refresh of the UI cache for this org. Support can trigger an immediate ledger reconcile for org_abc123. Long-term: we should make promo backfill atomic with metering or introduce a transient-cache hold.

alex_support: @matt_oncall please run reconcile. @jane_cust I will DM you when done.

matt_oncall: Reconcile executed at 2026-03-15T16:05:30Z for org_abc123. Ledger adjusted: credit_remaining updated from -5.40 -> 12.60. Please refresh your Billing page (hard refresh).

jane_cust: Confirmed — dashboard now shows 12.60 remaining. Thanks! :tada:

alex_support: Closing loop: root cause = race between promo backfill and metering snapshot leading to UI snapshot showing negative balance. Action items: (1) Engineering to add small locking or ordering guarantee for promo assignments (ticket ENG-5378), (2) Reduce reconcile window from 10min to 2min for high-throughput orgs (ops ticket OPS-221), (3) Add dashboard warning for 'reconciling' state to avoid alarming negative numbers.

jane_cust: Appreciate the quick turnaround.
